# hyperfluid_virtual_machine_images (Data Source)

The images an environment can boot a virtual machine from. Reading it needs the `virtual_machine:create` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_environment" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

data "hyperfluid_virtual_machine_images" "catalog" {
  env = data.hyperfluid_environment.default.id
}

output "disk_images" {
  value = [for i in data.hyperfluid_virtual_machine_images.catalog.images : i.image_key if i.kind == "disk"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `env` (String) Environment id.

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) Enabled images, each with the `image_source_ref` and `image_key` a virtual machine takes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) What the platform team wrote about the image.
- `image_key` (String) Image key.
- `image_source_ref` (String) Image source name.
- `kind` (String) `disk` (boots as is) or `installer` (installs onto a blank disk).
